feedback: The confession follows the source-and-glass chain already available and resolves Vincent's otherwise conspicuous model claim directly. Taking poison at the preview and adding it later is an admission of the inferred act, not an unexpected mechanism needed to solve the case. His emotional comparison with Dada grows from the earlier dinner material and gives the outcome more weight than another payment complaint alone would. Chip and Elle's innocent revelations also fit their established documents, so their suspicious behavior is paid off rather than discarded. The ending feels earned within the game's logic, though it confirms rather than repairs the absence of exclusive physical proof. The final turn toward personal responsibility is satisfying and concise.
